project_title: Distribuidora Buenos Aires E-commerce & Admin CMS

storefront.topbar: Sticky/fixed notice banner for sales, free shipping, or financing offers in ARS with switcher ARS/USD
storefront.header: Clean white or dark navbar with brand logo, multi-level hover menu, Mercado Libre-style autocomplete search input with instant thumbnail dropdown, cart drawer trigger, user menu
storefront.hero_section: Modular slider featuring high-res car interior seat covers and steering wheel craftsmanship, CTA buttons
storefront.categories_grid: Bento or card grid featuring Fundas de Asiento, Cubre Volantes, Alfombras, Organizadores, Accesorios
storefront.product_card: Minimalist card with hover image switch, price in ARS/USD, badge for 'Envío Gratis' or 'Cuotas sin Interés', quick add to cart, sale price highlight using var(--sale)
storefront.product_detail: Gallery with zoom, interactive variant selectors (material, color, car brand/model fit), stock indicator, price calculator, financing breakdown (e.g. 3 cuotas sin interés), direct WhatsApp consultation button, add to cart
storefront.cart_drawer: Slide-over drawer with item preview, quantity controls, shipping cost estimator, promo code input, direct checkout trigger
storefront.checkout: 3-step accordion checkout: datos personales, opción de envío/retiro en local, método de pago (Mercado Pago, transferencia bancaria con descuento, contra entrega), confirmación con envío automático a WhatsApp
storefront.footer: Deep dark background, brand info, store locator map preview, payment method icons, social links, floating WhatsApp action button

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation + topbar header with theme switcher and currency toggle
admin_dashboard.dashboard_home: Analytics charts (sales in ARS/USD, top selling products, recent orders status, conversion rate)
admin_dashboard.theme_builder: Real-time theme customizer with color pickers for all CSS variables (--primary, --secondary, --bg-main, --bg-card, --bg-header, --bg-footer, --text-main, --btn, --sale, --radius, --font-family), font family selector, radius control, and live storefront preview iframe/view
admin_dashboard.drag_drop_home_editor: Reorderable section list (Hero Slider, Categories, Featured Products, Promo Banners, Testimonials, FAQ) with toggle enable/disable
admin_dashboard.section_editors: Editors for Header, Topbar, Search, Popup, Footer, Floating WhatsApp, Extra Pages (Nosotros, Términos, FAQ)
admin_dashboard.crud_modules: Complete CRUD tables with filters and pagination for Products & Variants, Categories, Brands (Marcas), Product Types (Tipos), Bulk Prices (Precios Masivos), Coupons, Orders, Users, Payment Gateways

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read theme configurations from ThemeContext injecting dynamic CSS variables on document.documentElement component level or root element.

2. All buttons, headers, cards, badges, and textual accents must strictly use standard style expressions referring to var(--primary), var(--secondary), var(--bg-main), var(--bg-card), var(--bg-header), var(--bg-footer), var(--text-main), var(--btn), var(--sale), var(--radius), var(--font-family).
3. Implement Mercado Libre style instant autocomplete search in header displaying item image thumbnail, title, brand tag, price (ARS/USD), and stock status pill.
4. Ensure currency switcher dynamically recalculates prices across Storefront (e.g. 1 USD = 1100 ARS rate configurable in admin).
5. Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, and filters include explicit data-testid attributes (kebab-case).
6. Build the live preview in Theme Customizer so changing color pickers immediately reflects on the storefront preview mode.
7. Include full Spanish language copy for all storefront components, messages, popups, checkout steps, and admin tools.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role/function based (e.g., data-testid="search-input", data-testid="cart-drawer-toggle", data-testid="checkout-submit-button", data-testid="admin-theme-primary-color-picker")
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_requirement: All dynamic CSS background and text combinations must maintain accessible contrast ratio (>= 4.5:1 for standard text).
